title: Bashar :: Believing is Seeing PM Session - Highlights
author: Bashar Channeled by Darryl Anka
opening_summary: Bashar discusses AI's predictive capabilities, explaining that artificial intelligence can synthesize vast amounts of information faster than human minds, sometimes detecting patterns and probabilistic outcomes that humans might miss. He clarifies that all predictions are fundamentally readings of present energy rather than glimpses of a fixed future. Importantly, he notes that predictions can become self-obsolete once awareness spreads about them—if people prefer an alternative outcome, they can shift the energy trajectory. This reflects his broader teaching that consciousness and awareness shape reality.

quotes.quote: AI has the ability to synthesize more information than a human mind
All predictions are a sensing of the energy that exists at the moment
A prediction can render itself obsolete by being told
If that's not something you can prefer, you can change the course
